source.quote: iFi audio's own page for the ZEN Air DAC 2, read 2026-11-24 in a browser. The entire « Specifications » block's digital content is one row: « HI-RES SUPPORT PCM 384kHz; DSD256 ». No input list, no DAC chip, no digital filter, no bit depth.

_une_fiche_dune_seule_ligne_et_elle_vaut: One row of digital specification on the whole page - not even a list of inputs. The record reaches level 2 on the two figures that matter most to an engine (what PCM rate and what DSD rate the device will take) and says nothing else. Written rather than skipped because a device people own is a device the engine will meet, and because the alternative - resolving it through the brand's catch-all - would hand it the Pro iDSD's figures, which are twice these.
